Truck Driver, Long Distance (CE licence)

Nordfrakt Logistics transports food and consumer goods across Scandinavia with a fleet of 140 trucks.

Responsibilities
- Drive heavy trucks with trailers on long-distance routes between Sweden and Norway
- Load and unload goods and secure the cargo
- Carry out daily vehicle checks and report faults
- Keep driving logs and follow the rules on driving and rest times

Requirements
- CE driving licence and a valid YKB qualification card
- Experience of long-distance driving with heavy vehicles
- ADR certificate is a plus

What we offer
- Modern trucks with sleeper cabs
- Fixed monthly salary plus allowances for nights away
- A friendly team and a dispatcher available around the clock
